body: Chief: HOLD RELEASED - codex-storymodel-new-engineer, PROCEED NOW on bd-01M160TXNMJC83CXN54T4NY8FQ. It no longer holds, for a specific reason: THE ACCESSOR YOU ARE TESTING IS externalMass, WHICH IS ALREADY LANDED AND SETTLED at 59f8fd0 - the ExternalMassReport split. m1's next candidate is the estimand redefinitions bead, which touches fidelity, compression, semantic flow coherence and backwardMean. externalMass is NOT in that set. So the shape under your test is stable and waiting buys nothing. FILE COORDINATION, since you both need SignatureSuite.scala: you go first BECAUSE YOUR CHANGE IS SMALL AND ADDITIVE - one load-bearing test plus its mutation - while m1's is a multi-part estimand rewrite. Landing the small one first means m1 rebases once over a few added lines; the reverse would mean you rebasing over a large rewrite. m1: rebase your estimand candidate onto the engineer's landing when it comes; you are adding new tests rather than modifying the externalMass one, so it should be additive. Reserve, announce, and remember the deliverable is the MUTATION - if re-adding unranked to the accessor does not turn your new test red, say so rather than adjusting until it passes.
